figs.name: offset-error-vs-span-error-diagram
figs.alt: offset error vs span error graph for a pressure sensor at 0 and 10 psi
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog plotting the two article cases: a 2 mV offset that shifts the whole line, and a span error that raises the slope to 11 mV per psi.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Offset error versus span error on a pressure sensor output graph</title>

<line x1="100" y1="420" x2="100" y2="120" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>

<text x="90" y="126.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">mV</text>
<text x="100.0" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
<text x="235.0" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="370.0" y="446" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10</text>
<text x="235.0" y="472" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pressure, psi</text>
<line x1="100.0" y1="420.0" x2="370.0" y2="170.0" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>

<line x1="235.0" y1="295.0" x2="235.0" y2="265.0" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>

<text x="205" y="80" font-size="20" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Case 1: offset only</text>

<line x1="490" y1="420" x2="760" y2="420" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>

<text x="480" y="176.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">100</text>
<line x1="490" y1="170.0" x2="760" y2="170.0" stroke="#f1f5f9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

<line x1="490.0" y1="420.0" x2="760.0" y2="170.0" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="490.0" y1="420.0" x2="760.0" y2="145.0" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/>
<circle cx="760.0" cy="145.0" r="6" fill="#e11d48"/><circle cx="760.0" cy="170.0" r="6" fill="#16a34a"/>
<text x="595" y="80" font-size="20" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Case 2: span only</text>
<text x="595" y="106" font-size="17" fill="#e11d48" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">slope 11 mV per psi</text>
<line x1="140" y1="512" x2="180" y2="512" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="190" y="518" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Ideal: 10 mV per psi</text>
<line x1="430" y1="512" x2="470" y2="512" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/>
<text x="480" y="518" font-size="17" fill="#e11d48" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Sensor output</text>
<text x="400" y="548" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Offset moves the whole line, span changes its slope</text>
</svg>

figs.name: offset-error-calibration-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to detect offset error with zero trim and span error with span trim
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the calibration steps: check the 0 psi output for offset and fix with zero trim, then check 10 psi for span error and fix with span trim.
figs.after_h2: Why Correcting Both Errors is Important
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to find and correct offset and span errors during calibration</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Finding and Fixing Offset and Span Errors</text>
<rect x="250" y="56" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Apply 0 psi reference</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="130" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,130.0 560.0,180 400,230.0 240.0,180" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="175.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output different</text>
<text x="400" y="197.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">from 0 mV?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="180" x2="600" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="580" y="166" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="600" y="144" width="180" height="72" rx="10" fill="#e11d48" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="690.0" y="174.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Offset error:</text>
<text x="690.0" y="197.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">adjust zero trim</text>
<line x1="400" y1="230" x2="400" y2="254" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="385" y="250" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">No</text>
<polyline points="690,216 690,236 400,236" fill="none" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="250" y="254" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="288.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Apply 10 psi reference</text>
<line x1="400" y1="310" x2="400" y2="328" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,328.0 560.0,378 400,428.0 240.0,378" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="373.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output different</text>
<text x="400" y="395.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">from 100 mV?</text>
<line x1="560" y1="378" x2="600" y2="378" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="580" y="364" font-size="17" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="600" y="342" width="180" height="72" rx="10" fill="#e11d48" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="690.0" y="372.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span error:</text>
<text x="690.0" y="395.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">adjust span trim</text>
<line x1="400" y1="428" x2="400" y2="452" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="444" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="250" y="452" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="476.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Both corrected,</text>
<text x="400.0" y="500.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">readings are true</text>
<polyline points="690,414 690,482 552,482" fill="none" stroke="#881337" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="552" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Both errors are systematic, so calibration can remove them</text>
</svg>

figs.name: offset-error-zero-point-span-infographic
figs.alt: offset error, zero point error and span error compared with mV examples
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing the three errors with the article examples: a 5 mV offset, a 1 mV zero point error and a span error of 11 mV per psi.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Offset error zero point error and span error compared</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Offset, Zero Point and Span Error at a Glance</text>
<rect x="20" y="70" width="245" height="360" rx="16" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="20" y="70" width="245" height="70" rx="16" fill="#e11d48"/>
<text x="142" y="114" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Offset error</text>
<text x="142" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Whole output shifts</text>
<text x="142" y="250" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 psi: 5 mV</text>
<text x="142" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 psi: 105 mV</text>
<text x="142" y="350" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">same 5 mV everywhere</text>
<rect x="277" y="70" width="245" height="360" rx="16" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="277" y="70" width="245" height="70" rx="16" fill="#881337"/>
<text x="399" y="114" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Zero point error</text>
<text x="399" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Deviation at zero input</text>
<text x="399" y="250" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 psi: 1 mV</text>
<text x="399" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">should read 0 mV</text>
<text x="399" y="350" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">a type of offset error</text>
<rect x="534" y="70" width="245" height="360" rx="16" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="534" y="70" width="245" height="70" rx="16" fill="#e11d48"/>
<text x="656" y="114" font-size="21" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span error</text>
<text x="656" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Gain or slope is wrong</text>
<text x="656" y="250" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 psi: 110 mV</text>
<text x="656" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">11 mV per psi</text>
<text x="656" y="350" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">should be 10 mV per psi</text>
<text x="400" y="474" font-size="18" fill="#881337" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">All three are systematic, predictable and repeatable</text>
<text x="400" y="502" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Offset and span errors are independent of each other</text>
</svg>
